alt: Patricia Forest en séance de réflexologie plantaire, les pieds de la personne posés sur une serviette blanche
Patricia Forest en séance de réflexologie plantaire, assise face aux pieds de la personne qu'elle reçoit

emplacement: la séance, temps 2 : s'installer chez vous
alt: Chambre provençale au matin : lit aux draps blancs, coussin roulé, rais de soleil des persiennes sur les tomettes
consigne_scene: A sunlit Provençal living room in the morning: a low sofa covered with a crisp white cotton towel, a rolled towel cushion at one end where the ankles will rest, a folded natural linen blanket, a small olive branch in a stoneware jug on a low side table, terracotta floor tiles, warm stripes of sunlight falling through half-closed wooden shutters across the scene, empty and peaceful, nobody in the room.

alt: Tasse de tisane, carnet fermé et crayon sur une petite table près d'une fenêtre
consigne_scene: A small round olive-wood side table near a window, a cup of herbal tea in a simple stoneware cup with a little steam, a closed plain linen-covered notebook with a pencil on it, a sprig of rosemary, soft morning light, shallow depth of field, empty and quiet.

alt: Deux pieds nus posés côte à côte sur une serviette blanche, les jambes sous une couverture de lin
consigne_scene: Seen from the foot end of a sofa, two relaxed bare feet resting side by side on a white cotton towel draped over a soft cushion, soles gently turned toward the camera, the legs covered by a natural linen blanket up to the ankles, warm soft morning light, very calm, the rest of the room softly blurred, anatomically natural feet with five toes each.

alt: Pins parasols au-dessus d'une mer calme, sentier de sable dans la garrigue, lumière du matin
consigne_scene: Umbrella pines on a low pale limestone headland above a calm Mediterranean sea in soft morning light, a narrow sandy footpath winding through low garrigue toward the water, a wide calm clear sky in the upper part of the image, Provençal coast only: no tropical palm trees, no high cliffs, no buildings, no boats.

emplacement: ouverture, bandeau large sous le titre
alt: Pieds nus sur un sentier de sable et d'aiguilles de pin, au soleil du matin
consigne_scene: Close view at ground level of two bare feet standing still on a soft sandy path strewn with dry pine needles under umbrella pines, only the feet and the bottom of the ankles visible, a hem of light linen trousers, warm low morning sun from behind with long shadows, anatomically natural feet with five toes each, background softly blurred into golden light.

alt: Racines d'un vieil olivier agrippées à la terre rouge et au calcaire
consigne_scene: Close view of the twisted roots and trunk base of a very old olive tree gripping red-brown Provençal earth and pale limestone stones, dry golden grasses, soft low morning light, calm and strong.

emplacement: ouverture, photo à côté du grand prix
alt: Pile de serviettes blanches sur un tabouret en olivier, bol de galets, rais de soleil sur un mur blanc
consigne_scene: A neatly folded stack of white cotton towels on a light olive-wood stool, a small stoneware bowl of smooth grey and beige pebbles beside it, warm stripes of sunlight from wooden shutters on a limestone-white wall, terracotta floor tiles, minimal and calm, nobody.

emplacement: ouverture, photo à côté du formulaire
alt: Porte d'entrée provençale entrouverte, seuil en terre cuite au soleil, pots de romarin
consigne_scene: A Provençal front door of weathered pale sage-green painted wood standing slightly ajar, a sunlit terracotta doorstep, a pot of rosemary and a pot of lavender beside it, pale limestone wall, warm morning light and soft shadows, nobody, no house number, no letters.

alt: Traces de pas nus dans le sable mouillé qui s'arrêtent au bord de l'eau
consigne_scene: A trail of bare footprints in smooth wet sand on an empty Mediterranean beach in soft morning light, the footprints stop halfway and a thin sheet of foam slides over the sand, calm pale sea and sky in the upper part, nobody.
